name: Dan Holler
current_role: Counselor of the Department of State (since May 2026)
summary: Dan Holler became counselor of the State Department on May 26, 2026, succeeding Michael Needham when Needham moved to the White House as deputy national security adviser; he was also acting director of policy planning until August. He had been Rubio’s chief of staff since September 2025, and earlier worked at Heritage Action for America and in Rubio’s Senate office.
